method_note: Chart-agnostic classification (per charter §Ω2 + line 1263: relevance rules MUST be chart-agnostic). Precedence: (1) classical linkage→primary, (2) structural derivation→structural, (3) existing domain tags→tagged, (4) default-include-on-uncertainty→structural. Two named escapes: domain_agnostic:true and excluded:{domain,rule_id}. INVARIANT: for every non-agnostic concept, relevant_domains ∪ excluded_domains == the full tracked-domain set, disjointly — so a domain’s C7 slice S(domain) = {concepts where domains[domain] present}; every non-relevant domain carries a named exclusion (zero unreasoned exclusions).

EXC-MED-01.scope: medical/mortality/longevity computation excluded from material achievement domains
EXC-MED-01.reason: A pure medical / mortality / ayurdaya(longevity) computation is a physiology & lifespan significator, not a dhana(2nd/11th, wealth) or karma(10th, career) significator. Mirrors the charter Ω2 canonical exemplar: ga_medical_indications is excluded from a wealth reading. The concept remains relevant to health & longevity.

EXC-MUH-01.scope: electional/muhurta daily-window reference point excluded from natal domain slices
EXC-MUH-01.reason: A muhurta / kalam daily-window point (rahu-kalam, gulika-kalam, choghadiya, hora, abhijit, durmuhurta, varjyam, sandhya windows, etc.) computed for the birth instant is an electional timing input, not a natal significator of any life-outcome domain. It is relevant only to the timing and remedial(muhurta-selection) domains.

EXC-REM-01.scope: remedy delivery-mechanism category excluded from predictive domain slices
EXC-REM-01.reason: A remedy delivery-mechanism category (gemstone / mantra / charity dispatch type) is a remedial-domain concept describing how a remedy is administered; it is not a predictive natal significator of any life-outcome domain. Relevant only to the remedial domain.

EXC-DTE-01.scope: domain-typed enumeration concept: excluded from every domain except the one it enumerates
EXC-DTE-01.reason: This concept IS the bucket for a single named domain (e.g. a convergence-domain / question-lens / phaladesa-domain enumeration row for domain X). By construction it belongs to domain X only; every other domain is excluded because the row does not carry cross-domain signification — it is that one domain’s own classification container.

relevance_levels.primary: direct citable classical rule ties the concept to the domain
relevance_levels.structural: derives via house/lord/kāraka/varga/strength chains that feed the domain’s significators
relevance_levels.tagged: domain already tagged on the concept in the TCI/asset metadata
